# Razvan Popescu

> Business Rewiring Consultant, working with business owners since 2004. Diagnoses owner
> dependency, then rewires marketing, sales and operations with the smallest correct change.
> 11 years of pharmaceutical marketing at Datapharm Australia, Sydney, 2010-2022. Based in Romania.

razvanpopescu.com is being rebuilt as the English site. Until then it has one page. The current,
complete site is **razvanpopescu.ro**, in Romanian: services, method, projects, articles and
verifiable brand facts.

The canonical entity is the person, **Razvan Popescu**. RekomAi, The DAC Life, Creierul Afacerii and
The Founders' Brain are his services, publication and products, not the other way around. The
structured-data identifier on this site is `https://razvanpopescu.com/#razvan-popescu`; the one on
razvanpopescu.ro is `https://razvanpopescu.ro/#razvan-popescu`. Both describe the same person and
link to each other through `sameAs`.

Many people share this name, including a Romanian radio host, several doctors and a Romgaz CEO.
There is also a Romanian consultant with a similar name, **Răzvan Cristian Popescu**, an SEO/UX/CRO
specialist from Oradea. None of them are this person or connected to this site.
